correctness.rationale: In an extraspecial exponent-p group, every nonidentity cyclic subgroup has order p and the commutator induces a nondegenerate alternating form on the 2n-dimensional quotient by the center. Each projective point has an elementary-abelian order-p^2 preimage containing exactly p noncentral cyclic subgroups besides the center. Two noncentral cyclic subgroups permute exactly when they commute, which is exactly orthogonality of their quotient lines. A projective line has (p^(2n-1)-1)/(p-1) orthogonal projective points, giving the exact partner count and formula. The packaged replay enumerates all cyclic subgroups and all permuting pairs in four explicit finite Heisenberg groups.

originality.rationale: The 2017 primary source develops cyclic subgroup commutativity formulas and asymptotics for ZM-groups and explicitly motivates further study of the attainable values and structural behavior of csd. The 2016 foundational source contains only the rank-one extraspecial value for E(p^3), used as a local obstruction in an Iwasawa criterion. Neither inspected source states the arbitrary-rank extraspecial formula, the p-fold symplectic-projective fiber description, or the fixed-p limit 1/p. Targeted published-result and web searches found no equivalent theorem.
